steps.speaker: Fans (in unison)
steps.content: <size=50>Phanuel! Angel! Phanuel! Angel!</size>

When you reach the floor, the scene you witness is suffocating. Tens of thousands of faces, blank and blissful in a sickening sort of way. Their shrill, frenzied screams rise in layers upon layers, their light sticks sweeping in perfect unison, ultimately forming one terrifying wave of collective rapture.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Anomaly detected! The glow stick signal hub has been completely destroyed, yet the crowd's Mania resonance remains uninterrupted. They are synchronizing autonomously. Contamination continues to accumulate.
On stage, Jane has been blasted into a corner and lies unconscious. Joan attempts to fight back, but her sonic resistance means nothing before thirty thousand devotees.
With a single wink from Phanuel, the crowd erupts in screams. An overwhelming surge of awe sweeps across the stage in an instant, snapping every last string on Joan's guitar.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Darn it...
MBCC guards and the full FAC team hold the front rows with everything they have, fighting to shield the audience inside from Phanuel's influence.
But the waves of mental corruption are unrelenting. All they can do is grit their teeth and endure. The defensive line is on the verge of collapse, every second draining beyond imagination.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: The Mania contamination is materializing. If even Jane and Joan can't hold out against it, then we probably...
Wynn looks up. Phanuel stands at the center of the stage. She's blinding, radiant beyond measure—the only light in the abyss, and the very thing that will devour everything.
That dazzling smile draws in the whole world's gaze. It almost feels like that void can take away everything real. The Bureau, work, the Mania crisis...
Just as Wynn's is about to lose her grip on reality, a solid barrier rises up before her.
[Shackles Effect]

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't look. Don't listen. Phanuel's power forcibly drags people into a delusional state of elevated M-value. Keep your mind anchored. The happiness she offers is a lie. Don't let yourself be assimilated.
The shackles extend, weaving together a shield. But it's almost like every cheer from the crowd below is striking the barrier, physically.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Bad news—your attempt to counsel Phanuel and turn her against her manager has failed. Continuing this standoff will drain your strength as well. The good news, though, is that given the current scale of contamination, I can secure a higher level of backup authorization for you.
Seeing no response from you, the bipyramid waves in front of your face.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Are you thinking of another plan of attack?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm thinking... maybe deliberately pushing her to resist was a mistake from the very beginning. Maybe I shouldn't have tried to drag a blank slate out of her comfort zone...

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: You urged her to find her own voice, urged the crowd to wake up, and now you're urging me to turn over a new leaf and cooperate with your investigation. Then what? Can you take responsibility for every single one of those thirty thousand people?
At the far end of your vision is Phanuel, standing at center stage. She's radiant and jubilant, her arms raised high, openly embracing the overwhelming adoration that has flooded the entire venue.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: My Cherubs! We finally get to meet again! Were you all wondering where your angel had gone earlier? And why there was a stranger up on stage?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Actually, Phanuel realized I'd lost something very, very important before coming on stage. Will everyone help Phanuel find it?
The moment the words leave her lips, a thunderous roar once more.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: It all started because I met a strange person recently. He told me that I need to listen to my own true voice, that I need to find my own answer, and that I can't keep living inside someone else's script.
steps.female_content: It all started because I recently met a strange person. She told me that I need to listen to my own true voice, that I need to find my own answer, and that I can't keep living inside someone else's script.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: And then he suddenly asked me: what kind of life did I actually want to live?
steps.female_content: And then she suddenly asked me: what kind of life did I actually want to live?

steps.content: As she speaks, Phanuel's gaze sweeps through the crowd, as if searching for someone. Then, she tilts her head, like one would when they're confused.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: What a deep, complicated question. Phanuel gave it so much thought, but still couldn't come up with an answer. But then, Phanuel thought of her Cherubs.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Phanuel is always the one listening to everyone's worries, but maybe this time, you could be the ones to help Phanuel out? So—

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I opened up the chat app's message board. And I heard your voices!
[Outside the Venue]

Eliza has been taken into custody and is being escorted into a Public Security Bureau investigation vehicle on suspicion of spreading Mania. Just as the car door is about to close, the familiar melodies of Phanuel's new song ring out from inside the venue.
She struggles against the officers, straining to crane her neck toward the venue. At the sight of the pink beam of light illuminating the sky, a satisfied smile crosses her face.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Yes, that's it. That's my Phanuel! Everything she sees and hears every day has been carefully crafted by me! That includes her desires.

She recalls Chief's confident expression. Even now, it brings her nothing but satisfaction. Because that person never understood—the glow stick hub had always been the least important piece of this concert.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: I should thank you for making her curious about freedom and self-discovery... She's now chosen, of her own free will, to be everyone's angel. It's <color=#FFC9F3>Phanuel</color> who held the biggest concert Eastside has ever seen. It is I who gave her that name... and it will finally be remembered by history.
She looks out the car window at the fans parading across the plaza and the posters plastered everywhere. Then her eyes trace the outline of Phanuel's image.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Congratulations. The attention you so desperately craved... is yours at last.
[Stage]

The stage has become a vast altar. The angel stands at the center of the spotlight, flawlessly performing the sweetness and warmth she has rehearsed a thousand times over, drinking in the devotion and adulation of the thirty thousand heads bowed before her.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: One voice said, "Phanuel, I'm graduating this year. Everyone's telling me to find a good job. But I don't know what I like. I don't know what I want to do, Phanuel. All I want is to be with you forever, but my parents won't allow it."
It's okay. Forget all of that, and just stay with me.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: And another said, "Phanuel, I wanted to learn to paint when I was little, but my family said I couldn't make any money from painting. So I gave up. But watching you up on the stage, smiling despite all the criticism, I regret not being as brave as you."
That's right, come. Be just like Phanuel. Smile forever.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Then there were those who couldn't find meaning in marriage, those who couldn't find meaning in improving, in repeating the same routine every single day... in chasing dreams, in living, and so, so much more hahahaha!
So many lost, worthless, hollow lives!

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, the crowds in the plaza are also being influenced by the Mania. They've blocked our reinforcements' routes, so it'll take some time for the main unit to arrive.
You look through the shifting layers of protective light, and at Phanuel on stage. Radiant, and yet a complete stranger.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What do you think she's saying?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Referencing her established patterns. She's adopting the angel persona to strike at the audience's vulnerabilities, leveraging their emptiness and confusion to reinforce psychic synchronization and intensify Mania bonding.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No... She's saying, help me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm the one who taught her how to choose. I brought her doubt and change, so I must see it through myself. Hold the line here for now, Triangle Face... Cover me. I'm going up on stage.
Phanuel spreads her arms wide at the center of the stage. Behind her, phantom angel wings slowly unfurl. Countless invisible wires extend from the wingbones, lifting her gently into the air...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I see, so everyone's just like Phanuel after all. None of us know what kind of life we want to choose.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: There are tens of thousands of people here right now. But it turns out that we were never the strange ones—it has always been those who want to protect their dreams, to stop disasters, to fulfill a mission, and to keep their friends safe!
She walks along the edge of the stage. And where she treads, the light follows.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: It looks like what Phanuel lost was my <color=#FFC9F3>true self</color>. But that's alright. I've made my choice—

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: You wanted a perfect idol, so I became perfect. So, if what you want is a vast, hollow vessel, filled to the brim with your voices, then I'll become just that!

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Look at me... Love me. Your eyes, your time and energy, your "self" that never quite belonged... Offer it all to Phanuel...
Let our worthless lives give rise to a star that the world will adore...
Phanuel reproduces the smiles and tears she knows by heart, performing the exact gestures her data says will move anyone—

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Phanuel doesn't know if this is right. But this is Phanuel's... the only answer I could find that truly belongs to me.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Yes... I want to be with Phanuel...
One, two, three... The murmurs spread like seeds taking root.
The crowd offers a hymn to the angel in unison. They abandon all thought, surrender their minds, and willingly step into the pink illusion.
The myriad wills dissolve into one, converging into a new gospel.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Hollow individuals are beginning to appear within the security forces and FAC as well... The protective barrier's coverage is shrinking...
[Small CG: Phanuel lowers her head, energy converging onto her, wings gradually spreading open]

Phanuel has risen into the air. An invisible psychic tide slowly sweeps through the crowd, gently peeling away and absorbing those wandering emotions. Every last shred of confusion and uncertainty is being drawn into her, becoming one with her.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Let those strange people with their precious sense of direction march on ahead. Let them continue sitting high in their thrones, telling others what they should and shouldn't do.
The Angel spreads her wings, the idol opens her arms, and a false vision engulfs the entire venue—

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: My Cherubs, stay here with Phanuel. In this void that's begging to be filled. Lose yourself in the bliss completely, utterly, and...
[Big CG: Stage, Spread Wings]

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Enter Elysium!
